evidence.reason: The fixture creates two commits after setting only user.name and user.email. It never disables inherited `commit.gpgSign`, so on a host with global signing enabled and no usable signing key, the first commit at line 94 fails and every `DeployTests` case errors in `setUp()`. Setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit is the smallest hermetic fix and also covers the later fixture commit.
